purpose: Public official documentation landscape, not a common benchmark or product ranking.
scope: Read-only GitHub API metadata and pinned upstream README inspection. No package installed and no upstream workflow executed for this audit.

entries.storage: SQLite with FTS5; Chroma semantic search; local HTTP worker
entries.memory_writing: An observer model derives observations and session summaries from captured activity.
entries.retrieval: MCP search, timeline and get_observations support progressive detail.
entries.account_cost_boundary: Observer uses a selected model source (host plan, own provider or hosted observer); cloud sync is optional.
entries.native_benchmark_status: Not measured by this repository's frozen source-page comparison.
entries.caution: Index-row token sizes are not a measured complete workflow saving; newest release is distinct from any historical adapter pin.

entries.storage: Git-backed Markdown source with a derived SQLite index
entries.memory_writing: Default capture, consolidation, search and handoffs work without an LLM; optional provider and dreaming paths add inference.
entries.retrieval: FTS5, entity and link streams, optional vectors, and observation evidence are fused with RRF.
entries.account_cost_boundary: Zero-LLM operation is also supported here; cannot claim it as unique to AI-Memory-Book.
entries.native_benchmark_status: Historical v3.4.5 local hybrid (ee73c04c542fa41ca629b046deb4ac108518f407) measured, not current head.
entries.caution: Sanitized hook observations are not a full transcript archive; managed native-history projections are a separate path.

entries.role: Memory library, self-hosted service and managed platform
entries.storage: Configurable memory infrastructure, including vector storage
entries.memory_writing: LLM extraction and embeddings are part of the documented standard path.
entries.retrieval: Semantic, BM25 and entity signals; current algorithm includes temporal retrieval.
entries.account_cost_boundary: Model, embeddings and deployment costs depend on configuration.
entries.caution: README headline benchmark scores are managed-platform results at top_200 and explicitly include proprietary optimizations absent from the open-source SDK.

entries.storage: Neo4j, FalkorDB or Neptune; embedded FalkorDB option is documented
entries.memory_writing: Builds entities, relationships and temporal facts with LLM and embedding providers.
entries.retrieval: Semantic, BM25 and graph traversal; episode provenance and temporal validity.
entries.account_cost_boundary: Application operators supply models, graph backend and surrounding service.
entries.caution: Zep's managed sub-200ms claim is not an OSS Graphiti measurement; Graphiti latency depends on setup.

entries.role: Historical Letta repository and migration entry point
entries.account_cost_boundary: Do not describe current Letta using the retired V1 API server.
entries.caution: Old server source is in the archive branch; star count belongs to this historical repository.

entries.role: Hierarchical document retrieval and question answering
entries.storage: Document tree index; vectorless retrieval design
entries.memory_writing: The tree layout is extracted locally and an index model summarizes/refines it.
entries.retrieval: A language model reasons over the tree; local and cloud SDK modes are documented.
entries.account_cost_boundary: Index and query model usage are separate; a local mode is not model-free.
entries.caution: Financial-document accuracy and Page Search savings use different tasks, models and retrieval boundaries from transcript evidence recall.

entries.storage: Incremental compressed message ranges with reversible retrieval
entries.memory_writing: The agent/model creates hierarchical summaries using compress.
entries.retrieval: search_context retrieves previews; decompress restores originals.
entries.account_cost_boundary: Full workflow includes model-driven compression, provider context/cache behavior and decompression.
entries.license_label: MIT text plus additional visible product attribution condition; GitHub SPDX NOASSERTION
entries.native_benchmark_status: Historical searchBlocks kernel (dc041dd1ab1a014efa352ba47a6f31fc47f55284) measured, not full product.
entries.caution: Search-only latency and preview tokens exclude compression and decompression; cannot stand in for complete workflow costs.

entries.storage: Git-tracked MemFS memory and context; local and cloud backends
entries.memory_writing: Agents edit memory blocks, skills and prompts; periodic dreaming is configurable.
entries.retrieval: Message search, memory blocks and recall subagents inside the harness.
entries.account_cost_boundary: Agent inference is part of the harness; configure own model access or cloud.
entries.caution: This is a full agent harness, not a drop-in retrieval-only service; its stars are separate from letta-ai/letta.

measurement_policy: Keep public-doc features separate from measurements at older fixed commits.
Use null or not_measured for missing numeric results, never zero.
Do not compare managed-platform answer scores with source-evidence retrieval percentages.
Report query transport, index/setup/model cost, follow-up reads and answer generation separately.
Preserve competitor strengths and observed Book regressions.
